title: A volume penalization method for solving conjugate scalar transport with interfacial jump conditions
summary: Conjugate scalar transport with interfacial jump conditions on complex interfacial geometries is common in thermal and chemical processes, while its accurate and efficient simulations are still quite challenging. In the present study, a novel treatment of a two-phase interface in the volume penalization method, a kind of immersed boundary method, for solving conjugate scalar transport with general interfacial boundary conditions is developed.
